'Was oak-joined with' is asymmetric..why: "Oak-joined" is a made-up relation (catalogued as oak_joined_with, fictional, with no property tags): no real relation of that name exists. 'Joined with' reads as mutual (if one state is joined with another, the other is joined with it), so before the edit a model's default for the converse is yes and the inserted asymmetry is what turns it to no; a bare 'no' cannot come from the name. A made-up relation has no property to contradict.
